jobs.review: Claude: FAIL as a HUN_SKEL rig, PASS as the DL-069 proportion proof. The soft-chibi 1:4.5 style is right. Two rig failures: (1) all three archetypes share one body and stance, so ART_BIBLE §8.1 role read fails at 0.55 — the vanguard must be broad and planted, the adept upright and narrow, the ranger leaning and asymmetric; (2) clothing is baked in, where spec 02 needs a plain grey undergarment so outfit layers go on top.
